# Day overview template

Instantiate only for an actual evidence-bearing day. A day without acquired and
reviewed sources needs only an explicitly pending README.

## State and scope

Record acquisition, raw ASR, curation, audio-review, and synthesis states
separately. State what evidence is missing and which processing/publication
gates are unresolved.

## Sources

Link the day source record: stable public URLs, permissions, retrieval time,
audio identity, parts, checkpoint identities, and exact validation results.
Do not include signed URLs, credentials, private contacts, or secret-bearing logs.

## Chapter index and coverage

Link semantic chapters by source-relative interval. Account for breaks,
transitions, omitted material, and unreviewed gaps. Distinguish schedule time
from recording time.

## Decisions and progress

Link separate decision and progress documents. Distinguish proposals, requests,
reported completion, demonstrated results, blocks, and reversals. Separate
workshop demonstrations from the team's live build.

## Lessons and follow-up

Link evidence-backed lessons/failures and the review queue. State limitations
before generalizing to other teams. Keep later-day outcomes pending review.
